name: etcd-dr-test
description: etcd-snapshot disaster-recovery / chaos test (Jest). Read-only asserts a <1h-fresh etcd snapshot exists in MinIO AND that etcd + the stored snapshot pass integrity checks; the destructive tier non-destructively exercises the snapshot->load restore procedure to a temp file (NEVER restores live etcd) and prints the bootstrap-restore runbook. Tracks TALOS-23l.6.
